sample_unit: submissions to challenge (SOAP notes from long doctor-patient recordings)

links.outcome: Hallucination rate of ambient SOAP notes by independent LLM-as-a-judge, compared with other submissions
links.effect: Lowest hallucination rate among all submissions; no absolute rate reported in the abstract, so hallucination is not shown to be absent.
links.quote: Our systems ranked first in both tracks, and an independent LLM-as-a-judge evaluation showed the lowest hallucination rate among all submissions, indicating that reinforcement learning against a concept-matching metric need not compromise factual reliability.

unlisted_practices: Reinforcement learning fine-tuning with a concept-matching reward (Open Medical Concept F1) for speech-to-SOAP note generation
Screening open-weight speech LLMs for long-audio robustness
Fine-tuning on text transcripts to transfer to speech input and improve out-of-domain robustness

screen.reason: Evaluates speech-to-SOAP generation systems on the BeTraC benchmark dataset, focusing on model architecture and fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, DAPO reinforcement learning) rather than health care organizational deployment practices.
